description.value:
♒ Aquarius rises Exalted today. This is the one day in two hundred and sixty. You have your Zenith Boon for the whole day.

As the Ascendant Boon, and you gain @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Aurora Execution] — usable once per minute.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-class-features.Item.Ascendant Constellation]. A Zenith is scheduled by the GM, never rolled.

rules.text: Cold damage you deal forces a Fortitude save against your Cosmo DC or slowed 1, cumulative; at slowed 4 the creature is petrified in ice. Your cold ignores cold resistance and treats cold immunity as resistance 10.
rules.title: Freezing Coffin
